scope: Two robots x two execution interfaces; at most 2 native seconds/case, known peak-rate saved initial states; component diagnostic only
initialization: Same exact archived peak-state full native_qpos/native_qvel and prior cached IK seed for each paired robot; no initializer IK or state correction; gripper command255
initial_velocity: Preserve all recorded velocities, including values already exceeding official references. Initial exceedance is reported, not erased or a reason to remove a case.
missing_state: Archived qacc_warmstart/act/ctrl/contact solver state not available; MjData defaults retained, except explicit gripper255. This is not an exact dynamical replay.
physics: Byte-identical saved XML, original .002s implicitfast MuJoCo, mj_step then mj_forward. No Warp/fluid/receiver external drive/pushes/new delayed observations/teacher/policy.
control_schedule: First control at restored native time; use archived peak actual_control_dt for that first target/FF. Thereafter every5 native steps=.010s, held FF unchanged between solves. Stop after1000 steps or first failed control/gate/native exception.
world_twist: Fix the same archived postnoise executed action rotated by its original historical action basis; no new observations, action changes, labels or clipping changes
Cartesian_target: At each control, position=actual_site+dt*v_world; rotation=Exp(dt*w_world)*actual_site_rotation. Same target construction for both variants.
old_interface: Byte-identical objective-only noninitial IK (positionweight20, orientation1, cached-q .001, one cached start,100nfev, strict1mm/.02rad) plus byte-identical held FF and original apply body.
bounded_interface: One lsq_linear fit min||[20Jp;Jw;.001I]qdot-[20v;w;0]||; bounds=officialvmax intersect originallocalMJCF0.03rad buffer Euler step. qIK_local=actual_q+dt*qdot_fit. Exactly one candidate scratch FK, require original strict1mm/.02rad against same Cartesian target; fail closed/no fallback.
held_FF: Original prepare_held(qIK_local,actual_q,dt,Kp,Kv); equivalent qdot to fitted value within roundoff. Held actuation nominal=qIK_local+(Kv/Kp)*qdot. Original bias-passive compensation, ctrl clipping and XML force limits remain. Kinematic cache separate from temporary actuation nominal.

pose_gate.failure: Record failed attempt and stop; no relaxing/retargeting/retry

ur5e.source_units: !degrees 180.0 for all six; converted to pi rad/s

position_limits: Original MJCF joint range with0.03rad buffer; no substitution of official soft/planning position limits
unknown_acceleration: No verified acceleration limits; no guessed acceleration constraint
records: Per-axis requested/actual rates vs officialvmax, initial exceedances included
Each solve accepted/rejected and original Cartesian step residual
Per-native-step actual Cartesian target error and separate constant-twist integrated-reference error
Original ctrl-range clipping, actual actuator/joint-force limits and observed forces
All started/failed/interrupted cases retained, native stop time and reason
interpretation: Euler joint-position bounds do not establish nonlinear/dynamical safety
Command rate bounds do not guarantee actual rate bounds, especially with initially excessive true velocity
Two-second native completion is not full-task, pouring, returned-pose, F-tier, DAgger, OPD or ICL success
No delay/teacher/18D/task experiment is changed; full23s and fixed20 pilot remain unauthorized
No tuning, branch search, parameter scan, seed deletion or retry
launch_conditions: Parent reads protocol/source/exact_solver_changes.patch, writes explicit root_readback and enables all3 runtimeflags; fresh CPU resource admission then run_once.py --execute-reviewed-once. No automatic launch.
